name: commit-conventions
description: Shopsys commit conventions — atomic functional units (tests with code, lockfiles and migrations with their cause), message format (lowercase, no period, present tense for behaviour / past tense for code changes, area and ClassName prefixes, no "fix:", never Co-Authored-By), when a body is needed, and the fixed messages for generated files and upgrade notes. Read it before writing or editing ANY commit message or creating, amending, splitting, squashing or rewording commits — whether the user asks to commit directly, wants only a message drafted, or another skill (adhoc-pr, nightly-triage) commits on their behalf.
